title: Field notes · 2026-W39
summary: A running notebook of ideas, builds, and lessons from the week.

projects.name: Previously approved
bullets: Audited cross-project development logging and identified the need for project-aware automatic activity capture.
Fixed older-draft preview compatibility and actionable errors, added earlier validation, and verified the rendering and editing flow with regression tests.
Created a detailed design study and isolated interactive prototype, with visual direction research and repeatability checks.
Reworked an interactive prototype around physical movement and validated a new traversal sequence.
Built and validated a free-skate gameplay prototype with connected park lines, trick combinations, scoring, and input checks.
Researched and refined interactive movement, contextual controls, and controller input with automated regression and visual checks.
Created a prioritized polish roadmap and researched affordable assets, import requirements, and subscription tradeoffs within a fixed budget.
Built and validated a browser-based creative experience with downloadable keepsakes and a shared gallery. Prepared static hosting; source publication awaits approval.
Improved mobile usability and accessible interaction paths; verified editing and downloadable outputs with automated tests.
Improved interface typography and spacing after visual review, with responsive behavior and production build checked.
Published a tested interactive browser experience with a public static site and shared gallery service.
Improved a mobile WebGL game with clearer readable controls, level-based progress feedback, a redesigned reveal moment, full browser-flow validation, and a successful static-site deployment.
Reviewed and verified a shared gallery architecture using a static site, serverless API, and managed SQL storage, including privacy boundaries and free-tier capacity.
Integrated freely available visual assets and refined movement presentation, contact feedback and camera behavior with functional and visual checks.

Expanded a WebGL customization system with mixed color channels, shade and brush-size controls, improved text readability, repeat creation flow, responsive QA, and a successful static-site deployment.
Created, tested, and published a separate full-screen mobile-first game interface while preserving the original UI and shared application flow.
Researched arcade sports gamefeel and revised ramp transitions, airtime and scoring presentation, with repeatable movement checks and a gameplay preview.
Refined the mobile game interface with a neutral pre-reveal palette and a distinct celebratory color transition, then tested and published the update.
Added a mobile-friendly family announcement opening scene, made the immersive game interface the default route, preserved the original interface as an alternate, and published the tested update.
Built and tested a music-driven arcade game prototype with branching physical routes, continuous playback recovery, and repeatable course generation.
Corrected the announcement screen’s true viewport centering, improved headline and supporting typography for readability, verified phone layouts, and published the update.
Expanded the tie-dye game with three additional fold styles, improved how fold and band choices affect final designs, tightened the mobile picker, and published the tested update.
Optimized an interactive browser game renderer to support substantially denser player-created designs, added automated performance coverage, and published the tested update.
Refined an interactive browser game layout so the primary action remains visible alongside all configuration choices on desktop, with regression coverage for the viewport behavior.
Updated an interactive browser game so its decorative creation numbering reflects saved shared-gallery entries and remains stable through the creation flow.
Removed two user-requested test entries from the shared gallery database and verified the remaining gallery records.
Reworked responsive game trays so the full creation flow fits short phone screens without internal scrolling, with automated viewport coverage and visual verification.
Refined three procedural visual patterns to replace dense competing contours with clearer rays, directional folds, and painterly pools, then expanded browser coverage across every pattern.
Applied the same cleaner procedural-art direction across the original visual patterns, replacing dense high-contrast details with broader, more readable forms.
Restored a subtle secondary contour layer across six procedural patterns to add fine character without overpowering their simplified primary forms.
Improved review usability, retained outstanding follow-up requests, and made saved quality checks available for assisted repair, with regression coverage.
Repaired embedded preview navigation and asset rendering, added reversible appearance controls, and assessed a future runtime migration with regression checks.

Improved review feedback and continuity during bulk actions, added evidence-backed correction controls, and fixed provenance preservation. Verified focused regressions and an isolated browser workflow.

Improved a music-linked skating prototype with route-independent timing feedback, tighter chase-camera behavior, expanded directional trick inputs, and more demanding manual balance; verified deterministic course and controller regressions.

Corrected a skating camera to follow horizontal movement, replaced distracting world-space timing feedback with a clearer pace display, and added in-game trick teaching plus bounded input assists; verified camera, route, controller, and import regressions.

Added a bounded automatic cruise controller and light steering stabilization to a music-driven skating prototype while preserving manual speed overrides, physical feature play, route choice, deterministic versioning, and full-route stability at multiple simulation rates.
Created and deployed a standalone mobile-first WebGL tie-dye game with a shared gallery, full color painting, bounded design data, and a companion link from the original experience.
Improved cross-device image saving for two web games by adding a native mobile file handoff with a browser download fallback, then verified and deployed both experiences.

Improved arcade movement and environmental presentation in a game prototype using free licensed assets, with regression coverage for controllable jumps, recoverable navigation and interactive scenery.
Improved collision reliability, added asset attribution and music-linked trick objectives, and validated controller and environment changes.
Published a branded outbound credit in the game footer and verified the production build and browser behavior.
Refined recoverable collision feedback and regression coverage for the skateboarding prototype.

Audited the new Cloudflare setup and confirmed the available CLI authorization can inspect zones but lacks DNS write access; the domain records await a Cloudflare dashboard login or narrowly scoped DNS-edit token.
Updated the custom-domain DNS to GitHub Pages and added the www alias; the site now resolves to the portfolio while HTTPS certificate provisioning remains pending.
Updated the portfolio's Discord calls to use the current community invite link.
Unified a game interface and verified navigation, dialogs, and layouts across multiple window sizes.
Refined an animated interface with richer lighting and particles; verified visual motion, reduced-motion behavior, and screen layouts.
Refined an animated background with drifting, blending color clouds and verified motion and reduced-motion behavior.
Diagnosed an online score-status issue and distinguished isolated test behavior from an external service failure.
Improved a game prototype’s native menu and HUD presentation, integrated free character and environment assets, and validated animation contact and navigation.
Clarified the correct GitHub Pages custom-subdomain configuration and the DNS/path distinction.
Explored four brighter, easier-to-navigate portfolio design directions that integrate a first-class games arcade experience.
Implemented a brighter portfolio workbench with an arcade landing experience, searchable project directory, refreshed resume and notes, responsive layouts, and static-export regression checks.

Refined an interactive arcade design to match its approved visual reference and repaired contact actions with an accessible in-page contact panel. Verified responsive layouts, interactions, and the static build.

Expanded an arcade portfolio with original cover artwork, screenshot galleries, on-demand video and playable previews, and accessible theater controls. Verified responsive layouts, media fallbacks, and static-site regression checks.
Expanded the project archive with supplied visual media and on-demand video previews, and built a responsive synthetic WebGL process walkthrough with playback controls and regression coverage.
Added a browser game to the arcade with original generated cartridge artwork, embedded play, requested ordering, and passing build and regression checks.
Published the completed static portfolio release through its configured GitHub Pages workflow and verified public deployment content.
Expanded the public project archive with fuller build records, system overviews, and careful scope notes, then verified the static site output.
Adjusted the arcade presentation so the cabinet fits more comfortably on desktop screens without changing the surrounding interface.
Published a production-only Rack & Ruin web build through a separate GitHub Pages repository, verified the deployment, and preserved a repeatable local publish command.
Built a secure database-backed project editor with rich media presentation, revision-aware publishing, and assisted drafting, while preserving the static public-site fallback.
Added evidence-based website enrichment for editable project drafts, including managed screenshots, media discovery, and granular manual media controls.
Provisioned and seeded the production project database; deployment remains pending account-level storage activation and configured access secrets.
Created production media storage and completed the release preflight; publication remains gated by required secure access configuration.
Documented the secure first-deploy workflow for protected project editing, including access policy paths, secret bootstrapping, and hostname handoff.
Expanded the arcade catalog with playable links and built an independent game showcase with individual pages, on-demand browser players, and media galleries.
Prepared and validated a secure production deployment, confirmed the platform resource state, and reached the final account enrollment checkpoint for access protection.
Reached the final free-tier security enrollment checkpoint and paused for explicit approval when the provider disclosed an overage billing authorization.
Deployed the database-backed portfolio editor behind managed access protection, activated the production edge route, and verified public content, project data, and restricted administration paths.
Refined the arcade into a responsive split layout that gives studio context its own desktop surface while preserving the compact integrated experience on smaller screens.
Published the responsive arcade layout update, separating studio context from the desktop game cabinet while preserving the compact presentation.
Clarified a complex review workflow with a shared visual overview, focused dependency inspection, and regression coverage.
Improved arcade access with Discord links and automatic video playback, refined archived product media framing, and released the updated portfolio and game showcase.
Updated project-media validation so existing same-site asset paths and HTTPS media can be saved together, then deployed the admin fix.
Prepared the standalone game site for GitHub Pages with a static deployment workflow and verified its production export; external publishing is awaiting refreshed GitHub and DNS permissions.
Published the standalone game-site source to GitHub with an automated Pages deployment and registered its custom domain; final DNS verification awaits narrowly scoped zone access.
Verified the custom-domain DNS points directly to GitHub Pages and diagnosed the remaining browser warning as GitHub certificate provisioning rather than a DNS mismatch.
Built a shared public game-catalog backend with private administration and verified the local database migration.
Clarified the public product archive, restored résumé-backed portfolio records, and connected a private game catalog to the standalone game site.
Improved the private portfolio writing assistant’s structured-response resilience and error feedback.
Added reliable drag-and-drop media uploads with format and size feedback to the private project editor.
Corrected viewport-centered presentation for enlarged project media.
Refined project media presentation and made project context responsive across desktop and compact layouts.
Improved the visual fit and aspect-ratio handling of client logos on the portfolio product page.
Rebalanced wide-screen project pages with responsive supporting content and fully contained media presentation.
Reviewed the public update pipeline and clarified the approval-to-publication handoff.

projects.name: Previously approved
bullets: Established the GitHub Pages publishing foundation and a review-first weekly development log for the public portfolio.
Prepared the public portfolio foundation for GitHub Pages, including blog and arcade routes, then committed the verified site changes.
Published the portfolio foundation to GitHub Pages and assigned jakedoesdev.com as its pending custom domain; DNS and HTTPS validation remain to be completed.

Diagnosed the custom-domain cutover: GitHub Pages is deployed, while the existing apex DNS still targets the previous destination and must be replaced before the portfolio can appear at its public domain.
